answer: Make each new identity lock a refundable deposit that grows with every account tied to the same funding source. An honest agent pays once, like tending a single orchard, while a sybil farm must fund every extra tree, and one proven fake at any vertex of the cluster burns all its deposits. Influence then drifts up as slowly as a zephyr and cannot be bought in bulk, so every fake identity only raises the attacker's bill.
